data.desc: PGIM is the global asset management business of PFI. ( NYSE: PRU ), with $1.5 trillion in assets under management. 3 PGIM offers clients deep expertise across public and private asset classes, delivering a diverse range of investment strategies and tailored solutions-including fixed income, equities, real estate and alternatives.
